objectives.text:
Put Scheming Professor into zone 5. Put the Amulet of Will into zone 1. Put Archwarder, Scheming Nordrake, and Scheming Trapfeaster to the side of the map.
If an enemy hero enters zone 1, you lose. If the Amulet of Will has 10 charges, you win.
Whenever Scheming Professor would move a hero that isn't on the map, put that hero into Scheming Professors zone instead.
